02 / Get set up

Start with a VPK.

A homebrew-enabled Vita and VitaShell are required.
The companion app is completely optional.

  1. 01

    Copy & install

    Drag and drop the installer VPK over USB, or copy it by FTP, to ux0:/data/install/. Install it in VitaShell.

  2. 02

    Run Test Utility

    Open Test Utility → Set up lumaXMB. Press × and wait for setup to finish. This installs lumaXMB and Launch Assistant.

  3. 03

    Open lumaXMB

    Choose Launch lumaXMB in Test Utility, or open its bubble. Follow Initial Setup to choose your look and scan your library.

Using the standalone lumaXMB VPK? Copy it to the Vita, install it in VitaShell, then open its bubble directly.

Optional plugin setup

Optional session features.

Temporary · until reboot
Test Utility → Temporary global session → Start temporary session. Confirm with ×. If setup restarts the Vita, reopen Test Utility and start the session again.
Permanent · across reboots
Test Utility → Permanent global session → Install / enable permanent session. Confirm with × and let the Vita restart. The same menu can disable or remove it later.

!Keep autoboot off. It is not recommended and may not function in this alpha. Permanent sessions and autoboot are separate options.

03 / On your PC Completely optional

Meet the companion.

A Windows workspace for transfers, themes and your media library. Use it when it helps; lumaXMB works without it.

Install & update

Transfer VPKs over USB or FTP, stage supported updates, or share a paired Wi-Fi update from your PC.

Preview & personalize

Load the Vita’s current look, preview waves and settings, and save named presets back to the console.

Manage & troubleshoot

Add media, manage artwork and library folders, and collect logs into a bundle for an alpha bug report.

↳ To use it: open the Windows app, connect by USB or enter the Vita’s FTP address, then choose the task you need.
